goal: Enable sending transactions and bumping fees via RBF to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses
Provide receiver privacy and address reuse prevention for wallet users sending to Silent Payment recipients
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (rkrux, w0xlt, rustaceanrob)
Unaddressed objection: MSVC compilation failure in walletmodel.cpp (Yudis-bit)
Contested objection: coin selection can pick unspendable leaf-only taproot inputs and abort send (Yudis-bit)
Unaddressed objection: metadata erasure on bumpfee loses recipient records if original tx mines (Yudis-bit)

why: P3 because it adds the scantxforsilentpayments RPC to inspect transactions for Silent Payment outputs
Extends RPC capabilities for downstream tooling without altering core RPC server infrastructure

Core component of BIP 352 wallet integration that also supports RBF fee-bumping for such payments
